basics.name: Audryus Leite
basics.label: Senior Backend Engineer | Distributed Systems | Java & Go
basics.summary:
Senior Backend Engineer with 15+ years of experience designing and evolving high-traffic distributed systems, with a strong focus on performance, scalability, and resilience.

Specialized in building APIs and microservices using Java and Go, with deep expertise in asynchronous processing, messaging systems, and system integration. Throughout my career, I have tackled real-world high-load challenges — including cutting critical response times from 13 minutes to under 2 minutes — and delivered solutions for concurrency control, queue management, and caching at scale.

Solid cloud experience across AWS and Azure, including Lambda, ECS Fargate, DynamoDB, SQS, and observability with OpenTelemetry. Proven ability to identify bottlenecks, simplify architecture, and drive continuous improvement in complex legacy systems.
